# Halberd — the Verbs (what the system does)

Everything the enterprise does, as functions: each takes information in and
hands one result on (→). A function is made of the functions indented beneath it, 4 levels deep,
with 2 to 9 steps at each level. The top level: detect, track, identify, decision, engage, assess.

```
Defend Against Threat  → Engagement Record
├── Detect  → Detection Set
│   ├── Condition Signals  → Conditioned Signals
│   └── Declare Detections  → Detection Set
├── Track  → Track Set
│   ├── Associate Detections  → Associations
│   └── Maintain Tracks  → Track Set
├── Identify  → Classified Track Set
│   ├── Characterize Tracks  → Track Features
│   └── Classify Threats  → Classified Track Set
├── Decide  → Engagement Plan
│   ├── Evaluate Threats  → Threat Priorities
│   ├── Pair Weapons  → Weapon Pairings
│   └── Schedule Engagements  → Engagement Plan
├── Engage  → Engagement Events
│   ├── Launch Interceptor  → Launch Event
│   └── Guide Interceptor  → Engagement Events
│       ├── Uplink Track Updates  → Inflight Updates
│       └── Home On Target  → Engagement Events
└── Assess  → Engagement Record
    ├── Judge Engagement  → Kill Assessment
    └── Report Outcome  → Engagement Record
```
